issue_context.title: index hints cause some logical optimizations can't be applied
issue_context.body:
## Bug Report

Please answer these questions before submitting your issue. Thanks!

### 1. Minimal reproduce step (Required)

```sql
CREATE TABLE t1(a INT, b INT);
CREATE TABLE t2(a INT, b INT UNIQUE NOT NULL);
EXPLAIN SELECT t1.a, t1.b FROM t1 LEFT JOIN t2 on t1.b = t2.b;
EXPLAIN SELECT t1.a, t1.b FROM t1 LEFT JOIN t2 use index () on t1.b = t2.b;
```

### 2. What did you expect to see? (Required)

The two plans should be the same.

### 3. What did you see instead (Required)

```
> EXPLAIN SELECT t1.a, t1.b FROM t1 LEFT JOIN t2 use index () on t1.b = t2.b;
+-----------------------------+----------+-----------+---------------+---------------------------------------------------+
| id                          | estRows  | task      | access object | operator info                                     |
+-----------------------------+----------+-----------+---------------+---------------------------------------------------+
| HashJoin_6                  | 12500.00 | root      |               | left outer join, equal:[eq(test.t1.b, test.t2.b)] |
| ├─TableReader_11(Build)     | 10000.00 | root      |               | data:TableFullScan_10                             |
| │ └─TableFullScan_10        | 10000.00 | cop[tikv] | table:t2      | keep order:false, stats:pseudo                    |
| └─TableReader_9(Probe)      | 10000.00 | root      |               | data:TableFullScan_8                              |
|   └─TableFullScan_8         | 10000.00 | cop[tikv] | table:t1      | keep order:false, stats:pseudo                    |
+-----------------------------+----------+-----------+---------------+---------------------------------------------------+

> EXPLAIN SELECT t1.a, t1.b FROM t1 LEFT JOIN t2 on t1.b = t2.b;
+-----------------------+----------+-----------+---------------+--------------------------------+
| id                    | estRows  | task      | access object | operator info                  |
+-----------------------+----------+-----------+---------------+--------------------------------+
| TableReader_7         | 10000.00 | root      |               | data:TableFullScan_6           |
| └─TableFullScan_6     | 10000.00 | cop[tikv] | table:t1      | keep order:false, stats:pseudo |
+-----------------------+----------+-----------+---------------+--------------------------------+
```

### 4. What is your TiDB version? (Required)

master
comments:
Root cause: Index hints will affect access paths in `DataSource`. Unique key information is also collected from access paths in `DataSource`. Unique key information is needed for some logical optimizations.

Seems like we should collect unique key information from the table schema.

I think the expected behavior might be wrong according to [mysql index hint](https://dev.mysql.com/doc/refman/8.0/en/index-hints.html)

> It is syntactically valid to omit index_list for USE INDEX, which means “use no indexes.”

As the unique key should be ignored due to `use index()`, the outer_join_eliminate couldn't be applied.
Please check whether the issue should be labeled with 'affects-x.y' or 'fixes-x.y.z', and then remove 'needs-more-info' label.

review_comments: `getLatestIndexInfo` will try to get infoschema in `infocache` which is not initialized during `MockContext`. we let `MockInfoCacheAndLoadInfoSchema` to initialize the infocache and load the infoschema we need, otherwise the test will get panic.
